summary: User was introduced to Intradee by a person displaying an aspirational lifestyle and was persuaded to deposit nearly all available funds for guided trading. The platform displayed over 40000 dollars but demanded an additional fiat payment before allowing withdrawal and a similar platform later approached the user under the PowerTrade name.
user_mistake: Deposited significant funds based on guidance from an online contact
prevention: Research the trading platform independently before depositing / Do not send additional money to release displayed trading profits
